purpose: Post-seal addendum. Arms introduced AFTER the 2026-08-10 seal are scored ONCE on the sealed TEST subjects, all together, whatever their development results; none is dropped or changed on the basis of a development or test result. Declared before the development runs of these arms completed.

arms.feat_logistic_sub: 18-D vector averaged over the same sub-windows the deep models see; logistic
arms.feat_logistic_base: 18-D vector z-scored by each patient's reserved baseline (typing: Non-IED background); logistic
arms.feat_white_base: 18-D vector whitened (Ledoit-Wolf) by each patient's reserved baseline; logistic
arms.deep_cnn_raw_ea_base: repo CNN on baseline-referenced Euclidean-aligned input

scoring: fit on ALL development subjects; TEST scored once. Baseline-referenced arms reserve one third of each TEST patient's negatives as its baseline; every arm in this addendum, and the original analytic arms re-scored deterministically, are evaluated on that same reduced TEST set so they are paired.
